body:
GOAL
A tagged zmux that the host actually runs: the wrapper through the overlay, zp as the picker, pi-zmx as the agent surface, and one Emacs plugin.

DEFINITION OF DONE
- An unusable launcher never fails attach or loses labels, on any path.
- pkgs.zmx carries the completions, version and meta of what it shadows.
- pkgs.zp is built from upstream unforked, and resolves the wrapper as zmx.
- pi-zmx loads in host pi and in the jail's pi, and its tools work or are deliberately absent.
- ~/flakes applies the overlay to system and home evaluations.
- ~/.config/emacs holds the only dl-zmx.el, and za is gone.
- README and VOCABULARY state only what exists.
- A session started from zp, Emacs or host pi survives a WM and an emacs.service restart.

NON-GOALS
Forks of zp or pi-zmx, a reader, a TUI, a daemon. Unchanged from plan-v0.

ORDER
Wrapper fixes -> package parity -> zp package -> flake slimming -> docs -> release -> ~/flakes wiring -> pi install -> Emacs cutover -> host checks.
title: v0.1: a release, and the kit connected
